title: Opening of the Rutgers interview, Aug 11 1980
summary: Kirchner announces the date and place and proposes going chronologically; Sauter confirms his 1914 Brooklyn birth.

MR. KIRCHNER: Today is August 11, 1980 and we're sitting in the home of Eddie Sauter in West Nyack, New York, and my name is Bill Kirschner.
Eddie, just for the sake of convenience, why don't we go chronologically; that's probably the easiest way to catch everything.
On two or three different sources it's stated that you were born on December 2, 1914 in Brooklyn; is that correct?
